answer: Require every agent to climb a summit of verifiable work before it can transact: each completed task adds a small, signed delta to its reputation ledger, and standing only grows through real, checkable deliveries. A newcomer starts at the bottom and must accumulate months of honest work, like a willow that bends in the wind yet only grows stronger with each season, so spinning up a thousand fresh identities costs a thousand histories of real labor. Sybils stay cheap to create but worthless to use until they have paid that time in public.
